title: Make V2 the default homepage?
body:
V2 is officially out. Should we make the https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/ homepage the V2 one and then display a banner for V1 docs (or just a top menu item so it's less intrusive)?

It's not a big priority. But could still be confusing for newcomers searching for InstantSearch.js and ending up on the V1 website.
It's very easy to dismiss a banner because it looks a bit like an ad ("This website use cookies..." effect)

The hierarchy could be:

* / => V2 homepage
* /v2/\* v2 docs
* /\* others, v1 docs (so there's no need to handle 301 etc. for now)

The goal being to push V2 even more.
